title: all mask bits
explanation:
### Description

Test vtkImageMaskBits with various bitwise operators on a color image.

**input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkActor2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor2D.html) — actor2d.
- [vtkImageMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageMapper.html) — image mapper.
- [vtkImageMaskBits](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageMaskBits.html) — image mask bits.
- [vtkImageShrink3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageShrink3D.html) — subsamples an image by averaging neighboring voxels.
- [vtkTIFFReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTIFFReader.html) — reads TIFF image files.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
